Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You catch the spell’s shape in your mind and pull at the thread that holds it straight.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self or one willing ally targeted by a single-target spell from a visible caster within 4 squares.
Duration
Resolve once at the stated trigger; applied conditions follow normal decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Defense

Spend your Reaction before the recipient’s normal defense roll. Grant 2 Boons to that defense. If it is Strong, the recipient may move 1 square without provoking after the spell resolves. Make no additional roll. This does not cancel the spell and cannot affect an area spell.
